scope: 規格來自原生 URDF、公開硬體元件表與本站實際訓練記錄；真機性能尚未驗證。沒有量測的電量、續航與功耗一律標示待量測，不以 GPU 用電、PPO 更新數或模擬關節力矩換算電池。

status_legend.source: 原生模型或明確設定值，並非實機量測
status_legend.command: 控制／參考指令，不能當作實際最高速度
status_legend.measured: 指定歷史原生模擬片段的量測，非整體合格證明
status_legend.simulated: 本站 Isaac Sim 訓練結果的模擬量，不含電氣損耗與電池
status_legend.unverified: 尚未建立或通過可使用的驗證範圍

support_legend.trained_history: 有歷史 PPO 模擬影片可觀看
support_legend.store_trainable: 可在本站送 Spark Isaac Lab 真實訓練
support_legend.task_pending: 結構支援，需接入對應 task adapter

leg.name: Q1 Leg
leg.summary: 髖 3 軸、膝、踝 2 軸的完整雙足下肢，加上腰 3 軸與肩肘手臂；可步行、閃身、蹲起與上肢動作。
best_for: 需要腳踝姿態回饋的平衡動作

specs.label: 移動方式
specs.note: 每腿 髖 Pitch/Roll/Yaw、膝 Pitch、踝 Pitch/Roll 六軸。
specs.note_en: Six axes per leg: hip pitch/roll/yaw, knee pitch, ankle pitch/roll.

specs.label: 速度指令
specs.note: 前進方向的指令設定上限；不是實測最高速度，也不是閃身平均速度。
specs.note_en: Forward command cap; not a measured top speed or the average sidestep speed.

specs.label: 平衡回饋
specs.note: 策略輸出外另加 ±0.15 rad 的踝關節姿態修正。
specs.note_en: Adds ±0.15 rad ankle posture correction on top of the policy output.

specs.label: 電源匯流排
specs.note: 雙足專案目前沒有電池與馬達元件表；URDF 的 100 N·m / 10 rad/s 是模擬限制值。
specs.note_en: The biped project has no battery or motor component sheet yet; the URDF 100 N·m / 10 rad/s values are simulation limits.

specs.label: 電池容量 / 續航
specs.note: 沒有電池容量與實機續航量測；不能由 PPO 更新數或模擬力矩換算。
specs.note_en: No battery capacity or real endurance measurement; cannot be derived from PPO updates or simulated torque.

specs.label: 訓練硬體
specs.value: DGX Spark GB10 · Isaac Sim 5.1 / Isaac Lab · RSL-RL PPO
specs.note: 本站真實訓練使用的 GPU 與軟體堆疊；時數為預算，非成功保證。
specs.note_en: GPU and software stack used for real training on this store; hours are a budget, not a guarantee.

specs.label: 歷史 PPO 成果
specs.note: 歷史原生 Isaac Sim / PhysX 模擬影片；真機未驗證。
specs.note_en: Historical native Isaac Sim / PhysX simulation video; not validated on hardware.

leg.summary_en: Full biped lower body with 3-axis hip, knee and 2-axis ankle, plus a 3-axis waist and shoulder-elbow arms; capable of walking, sidestepping, crouching and upper-body motion.
best_for_en: Crouching, standing up and jump preparation
Balance motions that need ankle posture feedback

wheel.name: Q1 Wheel
wheel.summary: 髖 2 軸加膝連桿與驅動輪的輪足下肢，腰 3 軸與肩肘腕手；適合平地滑行、轉向與上肢操作。
best_for: 低能耗長距離移動（待量測）

specs.label: 移動方式
specs.note: 每腿 髖 Pitch/Roll、膝連桿兩軸、連續旋轉驅動輪；沒有踝關節與腳掌。
specs.note_en: Per leg: hip pitch/roll, two knee-linkage axes, continuous drive wheel; no ankle or foot.

specs.label: 驅動輪半徑
specs.note: 元件表的 200 mm 輪徑；來自雙輪專案的硬體元件表，非本 URDF 量測。
specs.note_en: 200 mm wheel diameter from the component sheet of the wheeled project, not measured on this URDF.

specs.label: 電源匯流排
specs.note: 元件表標示 48 V 電池匯流排（AK10-9 / AKE90），腕手用 24 V 降壓。電池容量仍待量測。
specs.note_en: Component sheet lists a 48 V battery bus (AK10-9 / AKE90) with 24 V step-down for wrist and hand. Battery capacity still unmeasured.

specs.label: 關節馬達（元件表）
specs.value: 髖/膝 AKE90-8 55 N·m 額定 · 腰/肩/肘/輪 AK10-9 18 N·m 額定
specs.note: CubeMars 資料表的輸出端額定值；雙輪專案 build_urdf 的對應，不是本 URDF 的實測。
specs.note_en: Output-side ratings from CubeMars datasheets as mapped by the wheeled project build_urdf; not measured on this URDF.
specs.value_en: Hip/knee AKE90-8 55 N·m rated · waist/shoulder/elbow/wheel AK10-9 18 N·m rated

specs.label: 電池容量 / 續航
specs.note: 元件表只有匯流排電壓，沒有電池容量、電流與續航量測。
specs.note_en: The component sheet only has the bus voltage; no capacity, current or endurance measurement.

specs.label: 訓練硬體
specs.note: 雙輪 Isaac Lab 任務（wheel_humanoid_lab）與本站 URDF 契約不同，需另接 task adapter。
specs.note_en: The wheeled Isaac Lab task (wheel_humanoid_lab) uses a different contract than this URDF; it needs its own task adapter.
specs.value_en: Not wired to this store worker yet

specs.label: 歷史 PPO 成果
specs.value: 滑行 3,800 updates（舊 24 軸契約）
specs.note: 歷史 RSL-RL PPO 影片；與目前 URDF 的控制契約不相容。
specs.note_en: Historical RSL-RL PPO video; not compatible with the current URDF control contract.

wheel.summary_en: Wheel-leg lower body with a 2-axis hip, knee linkage and drive wheel, plus a 3-axis waist and shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand arms; suited to flat-ground skating, turning and upper-body manipulation.

motions.label: 站立平衡
motions.description: 維持直立、抵抗擾動與回站。

leg.note: 歷史 stand / balance PPO；本站可用 motion tracking 重新訓練。
leg.note_en: Historical stand / balance PPO; retrainable here with motion tracking.

wheel.note: 歷史 skate/stand 策略（舊 24 軸契約）；需輪速平衡。
wheel.note_en: Historical skate/stand policy (legacy 24-axis contract); needs wheel-speed balance.

motions.hardware: 下肢全部位置控制軸；雙輪另需驅動輪速度控制。
motions.description_en: Stay upright, resist pushes and recover.
motions.hardware_en: All lower-body position-control axes; wheeled also needs drive-wheel velocity control.

motions.label: 側向閃身 / 跨步
motions.description: 左右起步、連續跨步與回站。

leg.note: 閃身步 6,144 envs × 8,000 updates 歷史影片；本站可送新訓練。
leg.note_en: Sidestep 6,144 envs × 8,000 updates historical video; new training can be sent from here.

wheel.note: 沒有踝與腳掌，側向移動需改以差速滑行，屬不同動作。
wheel.note_en: No ankle or foot; lateral motion becomes differential skating, a different motion.

motions.hardware: 髖 Roll 與踝 Roll 承擔側向重心轉移。
motions.description_en: Start left or right, step repeatedly and recover.
motions.hardware_en: Hip roll and ankle roll carry the lateral weight shift.

motions.label: 前進行走

leg.note: task 有 walk skill（0.22 m/s 指令），本站尚未提供走路 reference。
leg.note_en: The task has a walk skill (0.22 m/s command); this store has no walking reference yet.

motions.hardware: 膝與髖 Pitch 的擺腿力矩；腳底摩擦。
motions.hardware_en: Knee and hip pitch swing torque; sole friction.

motions.label: 蹲起 / 起跳準備

leg.note: 本站 YouTube 片段辨識後可送 Spark 訓練（motion tracking）。
leg.note_en: YouTube segments recognized here can be sent to Spark training (motion tracking).

wheel.note: 膝連桿加驅動輪結構不支援離地起跳。
wheel.note_en: The knee-linkage plus drive-wheel structure cannot leave the ground.

motions.hardware: 膝關節峰值力矩與踝 Pitch 範圍；模擬限制 100 N·m。

power.note: 完成本站訓練後提供模擬機械功（不等於電池耗電）。
power.note_en: After training here, simulated mechanical work is reported (not battery drain).

motions.description_en: Deep squat, stand up and push off.
motions.hardware_en: Knee peak torque and ankle pitch range; simulation limit 100 N·m.

motions.label: 上肢揮動 / 功夫手部
motions.description: 肩肘腰配合的揮臂、護架與出拳。

leg.note: 肩肘在 23 控制軸內；本站可送訓練，手腕手指鎖定。
leg.note_en: Shoulder and elbow are within the 23 control axes; trainable here with wrist and fingers locked.

wheel.note: 有肩肘腕手軸，需接入雙輪 task adapter。
wheel.note_en: Has shoulder/elbow/wrist/hand axes; needs the wheeled task adapter.

motions.hardware: 肩 3 軸、肘 1 軸；雙輪另有腕與手指。
motions.description_en: Shoulder, elbow and waist coordinated swings, guards and punches.
motions.hardware_en: 3-axis shoulder, 1-axis elbow; wheeled also has wrist and fingers.

motions.label: 平地滑行

wheel.note: 歷史 skate PPO 3,800 updates（舊契約）；新 URDF 需重新訓練。
wheel.note_en: Historical skate PPO 3,800 updates (legacy contract); the new URDF needs retraining.

motions.hardware: 驅動輪速度控制、髖膝姿態平衡。
motions.hardware_en: Drive-wheel speed control, hip/knee posture balance.

motions.label: 原地轉向

leg.note: 需以踏步轉向 reference 訓練；本站尚未提供。
leg.note_en: Needs a stepping-turn reference for training; not provided here yet.

wheel.note: 歷史滑行策略的 yaw 指令。
wheel.note_en: Yaw command of the historical skating policy.

motions.hardware: 雙輪差速；雙足需髖 Yaw 與踏步。
motions.hardware_en: Wheeled differential drive; biped needs hip yaw and stepping.

scope_en: Specs come from the native URDF, public hardware component sheets and real training records on this store; real-robot performance is not validated. Power, endurance and consumption that were never measured are marked unmeasured; they are never derived from GPU power, PPO update counts or simulated joint torque.

status_legend_en.source: Native model or explicit setting, not a hardware measurement
status_legend_en.command: Control / reference command; not an actual top speed
status_legend_en.measured: Measured on a specific historical native simulation clip; not an overall certification
status_legend_en.simulated: Simulated quantity from Isaac Sim training on this store; excludes electrical losses and battery
status_legend_en.unmeasured: Not measured; no number is invented
status_legend_en.unverified: No usable validation scope established or passed yet

support_legend_en.store_trainable: Can be sent to Spark Isaac Lab real training from this store
support_legend_en.task_pending: Mechanically supported; needs the matching task adapter
support_legend_en.not_applicable: Mechanism does not support this motion
